name: mscse-readmitted-after-missed-semester
description: DGS Handbook §3.1 (“A student who fails to complete the ND Roll Call process and registration for fall and/or spring semester must complete the readmission process upon their return”) and §3.3 (“the program may require the student to reapply. The program may also reserve the right to reject some or all past credits”) — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-dh-3.1-3.13-3/-4/-9; DGS: “apply the suggested handling”. An MSCSE student who entered Fall 2023, took courses through Spring 2024, registered for nothing in 2024–25 and was readmitted Fall 2025: the courses from before the readmission count provisionally and wait for the ADGS, instead of counting in full with only a warning; the clocks still count from Fall 2023.

CSE 60641: taken before your readmission (Fall 2025) — the program may reject some or all past credits (DGS Handbook §3.3); the ADGS confirms
